cases.description: epsilon is pinned to ==1.0.0 in requirements.txt but ==2.0.0 in pyproject.toml. Each individual declaration is exact-pinned, so no unpinned-version flag fires — but the two manifests actively disagree with each other, which is a distinct, more concerning kind of non-determinism than an unpinned range: the resolved version now depends on which manifest the install tool actually reads.
cases.grounding: duplicate_detector.find_duplicate_conflicts groups by lowercased name; epsilon has 2 distinct version strings across 2 source files, producing one duplicate-conflicting-version flag at medium severity.
